population: Complete predeclared bounded 240-image qualification population: primary100 plus disjoint additional140; 10 pilot images excluded prospectively.

strict_accuracy_gate.basis: After the declared infrastructure-only recovery, the mandatory all-scheduled result is 128/240=53.33%, simultaneous interval [45.64%,60.87%]. The non-primary 128/207 retained-answer sensitivity upper bound is 69.50%, below 70%.

retained_answer_sensitivity.interpretation: Diagnostic only; does not replace the all-scheduled primary result.

image_transport_gate.evidence: Baseline records prove 158 exact source images; the declared infrastructure-only recovery proves the remaining 82. All 240 scheduled image-bearing tasks now have exact outbound source-image transport evidence.

image_requirement: All 240 tasks stage real MATRIX image.png inputs and no no-image control is used. Staging is not transport proof; the separate exact outbound proxy audit must establish that each supplied image reached the model.
mandatory_verification: Every retained answer was verified via /tests/test.sh inside its task Dockerfile image. Recovery replay did not rerun solver agents.
fidelity_caveat: MATRIX publishes five vision task kinds and data but no official vision evaluation rubric. The frozen full-credit binary verifier is adapter-derived, not official-exact.
